verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no official Adyen CLI. The closest items are the MCP server, launched locally via `npx -y @adyen/mcp` with flags, llms.txt and markdown docs, and OpenAPI specs. These are adjacent agent-facing surfaces, not a command-line tool for running Adyen operations, so they earn no credit. A payments platform could plausibly ship a CLI, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
